recommendations.name: Greg Fenton
recommendations.title: Enterprise Software Development and Delivery Leader
recommendations.quote:
Mashhood put together a fantastic workshop for a team of 24 software developers, guiding us from experimenting with AI to becoming true Agentic Developers. His knowledge, experience, and speaking style provided a level of confidence that is enabling our team to truly harness the power of AI for their work.

Thank you Mashhood!
